facts.raw_span: A 14-year-old girl presented with a 6-year history of a photosensitive eruption involving her face, neck, trunk, and extremities
Her symptoms began at age 8 years

She had previously tried multiple medications including systemic steroids, hydroxychloroquine, methotrexate, mycophenolate mofetil, cyclosporine, tacrolimus, tofacitinib, rituximab, and intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG), with minimal improvement
Violaceous erythema on forehead and midface
Diffuse poikiloderma involving upper chest, anterolateral thighs, and extensor arms
Erythematous, flat-topped papules on extensor joints of hands
Nailfold examination showed dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
Elevated serum IFN-β levels (8 pg/mL, normal ≤2 pg/mL)
Presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies
Radiographic evidence of myositis
Confirmatory skin biopsy performed

concepts.why: The patient's symptoms, including photosensitive eruption, poikiloderma, and erythematous papules, along with elevated serum IFN-β levels and presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies, are consistent with Juvenile Dermatomyositis.

The patient's history of photosensitive eruption, elevated serum IFN-β levels, and presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies, along with previous treatments, suggest a possible diagnosis of Lupus Erythematosus.

The patient's symptoms, including photosensitive eruption, poikiloderma, and erythematous papules, along with elevated serum IFN-β levels and presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies, are consistent with Mixed Connective Tissue Disease.
The patient's symptoms, including poikiloderma, erythematous papules, and nailfold examination findings, are consistent with Scleroderma.
The patient's symptoms, including erythematous papules and radiographic evidence of myositis, are consistent with Rheumatoid Arthritis.
The patient's symptoms, including radiographic evidence of myositis and confirmatory skin biopsy, are consistent with Autoimmune Myositis.
The patient's symptoms, including photosensitive eruption and poikiloderma, are consistent with Photosensitive Eruption.
The patient's symptoms, including diffuse poikiloderma, are consistent with Poikiloderma.
The patient's symptoms, including erythematous papules, are consistent with Erythematous Papules.
The patient's symptoms, including nailfold examination findings, are consistent with Nailfold Capillary Abnormalities.
